name: 贴合防滑一次性丁腈手套款
description: 戴取顺手、指尖防滑贴合，家务清洁与多场景作业通用

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless #FFFFFF for packshots, matte #22272B for work scenes, light neutral #E7EFE7 for flat lays and pain-point panels, real material surfaces at true hex for lifestyle scenes
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright even high-key studio light with front key and fill card on product screens; directional daylight-grade scene light at 5500K-6500K with soft skimming highlight over the hands; believable contact shadows under every object
styleLock.surfaceSystem: brushed steel #8C9196, used prep counter #6E6A66, butcher paper #F0E4D2, matte neutral board #E7EFE7
styleLock.typography: modern geometric sans-serif, headline plus two or three short label lines only
styleLock.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons inside one rounded pill or hexagon outline, accent color only
styleLock.presentationRules: hands and forearms only, no face in frame; worn-glove angle kept consistent across the set; callout panel always anchored to one corner and never covering the product
noDrift: no printed packaging artwork or wordmarks
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium utilitarian ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of seamless white #FFFFFF, matte charcoal #22272B, light neutral green-grey #E7EFE7 and one product-matched accent color; neutral studio lighting with a front key, fill card and believable soft contact shadows, daylight-grade scene light at 5500K to 6500K; modern geometric sans-serif; single thin-line icon style inside rounded pill or hexagon outlines; clean high-end product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; hands and forearms only with no face in frame; stable worn-product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no printed packaging artwork.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击：用戴取动作加开口盒装证明真实手部防护用途且完全合规。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, hands at chest height, full product and carton visible
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with fill card, soft contact shadows
shots.props: one plain unlabeled dispenser carton with its opening facing up and product fanned out
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace beyond even margins
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Straight-on eye-level view: one hand wearing {product} fully extended at chest height while the other hand pulls the cuff into place, a plain unlabeled dispenser carton sitting at the lower right with product fanned from its opening. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and a fill card, soft contact shadows grounding both the hands and the carton. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The product occupies 60-70% of the frame, no extra whitespace beyond even margins. Negative: no printed packaging artwork or wordmark, no watermark, no in-image text, no deformed or fused fingers, no floating carton without a contact shadow, no cut-off fingertips.

shots.displayName: 作业场景三行卖点面板
shots.intent: 主图一秒法则：在真实作业画面上用一块面板说清首要购买理由。
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle, working hands on the left third of the frame
shots.lighting: cool 6000K key from the upper left, soft pool of light on the hands, gentle rim behind them
shots.props: one cordless rotary tool in use, one rounded callout panel, one blank unlabeled carton thumbnail
shots.whitespace: generous negative space held inside the right panel for copy
shots.textZone: 右侧竖排圆角面板：顶部标题位加三行勾选胶囊位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Slight 3/4 angle: both hands wearing {product} working a cordless rotary tool at the left third of the frame, hands and product dominant. Matte charcoal work backdrop #22272B with a soft pool of light on the hands, cool 6000K key from the upper left and a gentle rim separating the hands from the background. A rounded vertical callout panel in {accent_color} anchored on the right, one headline slot at its top and three stacked pill rows with check marks reading 「{selling_point_1}」, 「{selling_point_2}」, 「{selling_point_3}」, plus a blank unlabeled carton thumbnail below. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space held inside the right panel. Negative: no printed packaging artwork or wordmark, no face and only hands and forearms in frame, no deformed or fused fingers, no fourth copy block, no invented numbers or grades, no watermark.

shots.intent: 放大一次性手套易破、松垮、失去抓握的日常摩擦，逼出替换需求。
shots.camera: matched two-panel framing photographed straight-on at hand height, identical on both panels
shots.lighting: flat directional key from the upper left, identical on both panels, honest shadow on the failing side
shots.background: light matte neutral field #E7EFE7 on both panels
shots.props: one split thin glove on the left, one intact worn unit on the right, a shallow spill mark
shots.whitespace: clean gutter between the panels, no copy room
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce pain-point split screen, two matched panels photographed straight-on at hand height with identical framing and identical light. Left panel: a loose thin disposable glove splitting open at the index finger, grip lost, a spill creeping across the surface. Right panel: {product} on the working hand, taut and intact, completing the same task cleanly. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Flat directional key from the upper left on both panels, shadow kept honest on the failing side, no drama added. Background light matte neutral field #E7EFE7 on both panels. The product occupies 40-50% across both panels, clean gutter between the panels with no copy. Negative: no readable text or comparison labels, no real competing product identity, no fabricated test results or percentages, no visible face, no deformed fingers, no watermark.

shots.intent: 把产品放进家务清洁的真实动作里，让买家一眼代入自己。
shots.camera: high 45-degree angle looking down along the railing
shots.lighting: cool overcast daylight from the upper left at 6500K, soft skimming highlight travelling along the creases
shots.background: brushed steel and stone step surface #8C9196 falling out of focus behind
shots.props: one plain unlabeled trigger spray bottle and one folded microfibre cloth, never covering the product
shots.whitespace: lower right corner reserved for the callout panel
shots.textZone: 右下角圆角面板：两行勾选胶囊位
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} on both hands cleaning a metal railing, one hand pressing a plain trigger spray bottle, the other wiping the rail with a folded microfibre cloth. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a high 45-degree angle looking down the length of the railing. Cool overcast daylight from the upper left at 6500K, a soft skimming highlight travelling along the glove creases, believable contact shadows dropped onto the steel. Background brushed steel and stone step surface #8C9196 falling out of focus behind. Props: one plain unlabeled trigger sprayer and one folded cloth, never covering the product. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, with a rounded callout panel in {accent_color} parked in the lower right corner carrying two label slots reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. Negative: no person above the forearm line, no face, no deformed or fused fingers, no over-smoothed plastic sheen on the material, no invented product claims, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用备餐分切的真实画面覆盖食品处理使用场景，扩大适用人群。
shots.camera: low angle from board level looking slightly upward across the food, foreground crisp
shots.lighting: warm practical light from the upper right around 3800K with a soft bounce on the near side
shots.background: used metal prep counter #6E6A66 blurred behind a plain #2B2B2B work jacket with the head out of frame
shots.props: one carving knife, butcher paper #F0E4D2, one sliced portion, nothing stacked in front of the hands
shots.whitespace: no extra whitespace, the scene fills the frame
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene: {product} on both hands carving and plating cooked meat on a sheet of butcher paper over a working prep counter. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Photographed from a low angle at board level looking slightly upward across the food, foreground slice crisp and the far counter soft. Warm practical light from the upper right around 3800K with a soft bounce on the near side, believable moisture highlights, shadows falling away from camera. Background plain #2B2B2B work jacket with the head out of frame and a used metal counter #6E6A66 blurred behind. Props: one carving knife, butcher paper #F0E4D2 and one sliced portion, nothing stacked in front of the hands. The product occupies 40-50% of the frame, no copy panel and no extra whitespace. Negative: no plastic-looking food, no insects or contamination, no unrealistic portion size, no face, no extra hands, no deformed fingers, no invented hygiene grades, no watermark.

shots.intent: 用指尖与袖口的真实材质微距证明贴合与抓握，替代口头主张。
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro at fingertip level in clean 90-degree side profile, tight zoom on the contact surface and rolled cuff edge, shallow depth of field
shots.lighting: low directional light skimming across the surface from the right, one controlled travelling highlight, no blowout
shots.whitespace: generous negative space on the left 40% for callouts
shots.textZone: 左侧留白 40%：两条细线标注位
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}, camera at fingertip level in a clean 90-degree side profile, tight zoom on the fingertip contact surface and the rolled cuff edge, shallow depth of field with the nearest ridge razor sharp. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Low directional light skimming across the surface from the right, one controlled highlight travelling along the texture, no blown speculars. Background soft out-of-focus neutral #B9BDBA. The detail fills 55-60% of the frame, generous negative space on the left 40% reserved for two thin-line callout slots reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. Negative: no invented surface texture that is not on the product, no blurry subject, no readable characters, no full hand anatomy outside the crop, no extra fingers, no watermark.

shots.intent: 俯视平铺交代盒装与可选规格结构，消除买哪个的犹豫。
shots.camera: flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle
shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting from directly above, minimal soft shadow under each edge
shots.props: one plain unlabeled dispenser carton opening up, fanned product, a row of blank rounded option chips
shots.whitespace: clear margins on all four sides
shots.textZone: 底部一行空白圆角选项块位
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce variant screen, flat lay photographed directly from above at a 90-degree overhead angle. {product} arranged as one worn pair laid flat, one folded single unit beside it, and one plain unlabeled dispenser carton with its opening facing up and product fanned out of it. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Even high-key flat lighting from directly above with a minimal soft shadow under every edge so nothing floats. Background light matte neutral field #E7EFE7. A row of blank rounded option chips in {accent_color} along the bottom edge carrying generic slots reading 「{callout_1}」, 「{callout_2}」, 「{callout_3}」. The layout occupies 35-40% of the frame, clear margins on all four sides. Negative: no invented size letters or pack counts, no printed packaging artwork or wordmark, no duplicated or fused items, no perspective distortion of the carton edges, no watermark.

shots.intent: 以留空证明结构收口降风险，真实资质由卖家后期合成。
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level, product centred with an empty proof column at the right
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio light, front key with fill card, soft contact shadow
shots.props: three hollow circular seal outlines, one two-row blank spec table, one plain unlabeled carton
shots.whitespace: generous negative space held in the right proof column
shots.textZone: 右侧空白证明栏：三枚空心印章框加两行空表格单元
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust screen, straight-on eye-level composition. {product} shown worn and centred beside a plain unlabeled dispenser carton, with an empty proof column held to the right: three hollow circular seal outlines awaiting real artwork and one two-row blank spec table of empty cells. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front key and a fill card, soft contact shadow grounding both objects. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. Two short generic label slots above the seal column reading 「{callout_1}」 and 「{callout_2}」. The product occupies 50-60% of the frame, generous negative space held in the right proof column. Negative: do NOT invent certifications, awards, ratings, lab data or qualification marks, no readable characters inside the blank frames, no brand wordmark, no fake badge artwork, no deformed fingers, no watermark.

provenance.notes: 共 7 张源主图，逐图事实：001 纯白底，一手戴好手套前伸、另一手正拉袖口的戴取动作，右下为开口纸盒并露出整叠手套；002 与 007 同构图近重复（仅左下尺码块个数不同），作业手部握持电动工具的特写加右上虚化，右侧竖向圆角面板含大标题与三行勾选胶囊，面板内嵌盒装小图，左下角码方块；003 餐食分切场景，深色工作夹克躯干无脸，戴手套的手在油纸上切熟肉，右侧圆角面板大标题加三个六边形勾选图标；004 美容调色场景，两位可辨识模特正脸同框，顶部大标题，右下绿色面板四个六边形图标（含无粉、无乳胶类主张）；005 诊室场景，医护与患者正脸同框，右侧圆角面板九行职业清单加一枚盾牌图标；006 清洁场景，一手按喷洒瓶一手持布擦拭金属栏杆，灰阶虚化背景，右上大标题加右下圆角面板一段说明与三行勾选胶囊。品类判定依据：源类目路径挂医疗检查用途，但按图判定主用途为家务清洁、备餐与多场景作业的一次性手部防护（清洁、餐食、作业场景占多数，医疗仅为场景之一），故取家居日用 / 防护（L2 逐字命中），leaf 为一次性丁腈防护手套。已剥离：包装盒上的字标与系列名、原平台店铺字样与角标、全部模特面部与身份（改为仅手部与前臂）、图内英文原句文案、厚度数值与医疗级/食品级/无粉/无乳胶等资质主张、盒数与尺码范围数字；上述内容一律以 {selling_point_n}/{callout_n} 占位或改为空心印章框与空表格单元等留空证明位。
